name: adjustment_key_unique
sql: /* Deliberately no DISTINCT: even an identical repeated manual adjustment is a review error. */ SELECT TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID FROM DMA_HEX.RAW.ADJUSTMENTS GROUP BY TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID HAVING COUNT(*) <> 1

name: current_orphan_references
sql: SELECT 'payment_orphan' AS ISSUE, p.TENANT_ID, p.INVOICE_ID FROM DMA_HEX.SILVER.BILLING_PAYMENTS AS p LEFT JOIN DMA_HEX.SILVER.BILLING_INVOICES AS i ON p.TENANT_ID = i.TENANT_ID AND p.INVOICE_ID = i.INVOICE_ID WHERE i.INVOICE_ID IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'adjustment_orphan' AS ISSUE, a.TENANT_ID, a.INVOICE_ID FROM DMA_HEX.SILVER.BILLING_ADJUSTMENTS AS a LEFT JOIN DMA_HEX.SILVER.BILLING_INVOICES AS i ON a.TENANT_ID = i.TENANT_ID AND a.INVOICE_ID = i.INVOICE_ID WHERE i.INVOICE_ID IS NULL

name: declared_grains
sql: SELECT 'silver_invoice_grain' AS ISSUE FROM DMA_HEX.SILVER.BILLING_INVOICES GROUP BY TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID HAVING COUNT(*) <> 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'silver_payment_grain' AS ISSUE FROM DMA_HEX.SILVER.BILLING_PAYMENTS GROUP BY TENANT_ID, PAYMENT_ID HAVING COUNT(*) <> 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'silver_adjustment_grain' AS ISSUE FROM DMA_HEX.SILVER.BILLING_ADJUSTMENTS GROUP BY TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID HAVING COUNT(*) <> 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'dimension_grain' AS ISSUE FROM DMA_HEX.GOLD.DIM_CUSTOMERS GROUP BY CUSTOMER_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) <> 1 OR CUSTOMER_KEY IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'invoice_grain' AS ISSUE FROM DMA_HEX.GOLD.FCT_INVOICES GROUP BY TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID HAVING COUNT(*) <> 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'invoice_surrogate_grain' AS ISSUE FROM DMA_HEX.GOLD.FCT_INVOICES GROUP BY INVOICE_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) <> 1 OR INVOICE_KEY IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_month_grain' AS ISSUE FROM DMA_HEX.GOLD.FCT_CUSTOMER_MONTH GROUP BY TENANT_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, INVOICE_MONTH HAVING COUNT(*) <> 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_month_surrogate_grain' AS ISSUE FROM DMA_HEX.GOLD.FCT_CUSTOMER_MONTH GROUP BY CUSTOMER_MONTH_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) <> 1 OR CUSTOMER_MONTH_KEY IS NULL

name: fact_balance_and_customer_binding
sql: SELECT i.TENANT_ID, i.INVOICE_ID FROM DMA_HEX.GOLD.FCT_INVOICES AS i LEFT JOIN DMA_HEX.GOLD.DIM_CUSTOMERS AS c ON i.CUSTOMER_KEY = c.CUSTOMER_KEY WHERE i.NET_CENTS <> i.AMOUNT_CENTS + i.ADJUSTMENT_CENTS OR i.OUTSTANDING_CENTS <> i.NET_CENTS - i.PAID_CENTS OR c.CUSTOMER_KEY IS NULL OR i.TENANT_ID <> c.TENANT_ID OR i.CUSTOMER_ID <> c.CUSTOMER_ID OR i.SEGMENT <> c.SEGMENT OR i.INVOICE_DATE < c.VALID_FROM OR (NOT c.VALID_TO IS NULL AND i.INVOICE_DATE >= c.VALID_TO)

name: invoice_history_exactly_one
sql: SELECT i.TENANT_ID, i.INVOICE_ID FROM DMA_HEX.SILVER.BILLING_INVOICES AS i LEFT JOIN DMA_HEX.GOLD.DIM_CUSTOMERS AS c ON i.TENANT_ID = c.TENANT_ID AND i.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID AND i.INVOICE_DATE >= c.VALID_FROM AND (i.INVOICE_DATE < c.VALID_TO OR c.VALID_TO IS NULL) GROUP BY i.TENANT_ID, i.INVOICE_ID HAVING COUNT(c.CUSTOMER_KEY) <> 1

name: payment_reconciliation
sql: WITH payments AS (SELECT TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID, SUM(PAID_CENTS) AS EXPECTED_PAID_CENTS FROM DMA_HEX.SILVER.BILLING_PAYMENTS GROUP BY TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID) SELECT i.TENANT_ID, i.INVOICE_ID FROM DMA_HEX.GOLD.FCT_INVOICES AS i LEFT JOIN payments AS p ON i.TENANT_ID = p.TENANT_ID AND i.INVOICE_ID = p.INVOICE_ID WHERE i.PAID_CENTS <> COALESCE(p.EXPECTED_PAID_CENTS, 0)

name: source_history_overlap
sql: WITH distinct_history AS (SELECT DISTINCT TENANT_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, SEGMENT, CAST(VALID_FROM AS DATE) AS VALID_FROM, CAST(VALID_TO AS DATE) AS VALID_TO FROM DMA_HEX.RAW.CUSTOMER_HISTORY), numbered AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TENANT_ID, CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY VALID_FROM, VALID_TO, SEGMENT) AS HISTORY_ROW_NUMBER FROM distinct_history) SELECT a.TENANT_ID, a.CUSTOMER_ID, a.VALID_FROM, b.VALID_FROM AS OTHER_VALID_FROM FROM numbered AS a JOIN numbered AS b ON a.TENANT_ID = b.TENANT_ID AND a.CUSTOMER_ID = b.CUSTOMER_ID AND a.HISTORY_ROW_NUMBER < b.HISTORY_ROW_NUMBER AND (a.VALID_TO IS NULL OR b.VALID_FROM < a.VALID_TO) AND (b.VALID_TO IS NULL OR a.VALID_FROM < b.VALID_TO)

name: source_identity_and_required_values
sql: SELECT 'invalid_invoice_source' AS ISSUE FROM DMA_HEX.RAW.INVOICE_CDC WHERE TENANT_ID IS NULL OR INVOICE_ID IS NULL OR CUSTOMER_ID IS NULL OR INVOICE_DATE IS NULL OR AMOUNT_CENTS IS NULL OR STATUS IS NULL OR IS_DELETED IS NULL OR SEQUENCE IS NULL OR SEQUENCE < 1 OR TENANT_ID = '' OR INVOICE_ID = '' OR CUSTOMER_ID = '' OR TENANT_ID LIKE '%|%' OR INVOICE_ID LIKE '%|%' OR CUSTOMER_ID LIKE '%|%' UNION ALL SELECT 'invalid_payment_source' AS ISSUE FROM DMA_HEX.RAW.PAYMENT_CDC WHERE TENANT_ID IS NULL OR PAYMENT_ID IS NULL OR INVOICE_ID IS NULL OR PAID_CENTS IS NULL OR IS_DELETED IS NULL OR SEQUENCE IS NULL OR SEQUENCE < 1 OR TENANT_ID = '' OR PAYMENT_ID = '' OR INVOICE_ID = '' OR TENANT_ID LIKE '%|%' OR PAYMENT_ID LIKE '%|%' OR INVOICE_ID LIKE '%|%' UNION ALL SELECT 'invalid_history_source' AS ISSUE FROM DMA_HEX.RAW.CUSTOMER_HISTORY WHERE TENANT_ID IS NULL OR CUSTOMER_ID IS NULL OR SEGMENT IS NULL OR VALID_FROM IS NULL OR TENANT_ID = '' OR CUSTOMER_ID = '' OR SEGMENT = '' OR TENANT_ID LIKE '%|%' OR CUSTOMER_ID LIKE '%|%' OR (NOT VALID_TO IS NULL AND CAST(VALID_FROM AS DATE) >= CAST(VALID_TO AS DATE)) UNION ALL SELECT 'invalid_adjustment_source' AS ISSUE FROM DMA_HEX.RAW.ADJUSTMENTS WHERE TENANT_ID IS NULL OR INVOICE_ID IS NULL OR ADJUSTMENT_CENTS IS NULL OR REASON IS NULL OR TENANT_ID = '' OR INVOICE_ID = '' OR TENANT_ID LIKE '%|%' OR INVOICE_ID LIKE '%|%'

name: source_version_conflicts
sql: /* Nonempty results fail. Full identical CDC replays are allowed; conflicting same-sequence rows are not. */ WITH invoices AS (SELECT DISTINCT TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, INVOICE_DATE, AMOUNT_CENTS, STATUS, IS_DELETED, SEQUENCE FROM DMA_HEX.RAW.INVOICE_CDC), payments AS (SELECT DISTINCT TENANT_ID, PAYMENT_ID, INVOICE_ID, PAID_CENTS, IS_DELETED, SEQUENCE FROM DMA_HEX.RAW.PAYMENT_CDC) SELECT 'invoice_version_conflict' AS ISSUE, TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID AS BUSINESS_ID FROM invoices GROUP BY TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID, SEQUENCE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'payment_version_conflict' AS ISSUE, TENANT_ID, PAYMENT_ID AS BUSINESS_ID FROM payments GROUP BY TENANT_ID, PAYMENT_ID, SEQUENCE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
